Frequently Asked Questions
Is the Han 86 meta in Warzone?
The Han 86 is currently ranked as Meta in Warzone. Its current pick rate is 4.2%, which shows how popular the weapon is compared to other options.
What is the best Han 86 Loadout?
The best Han 86 Loadout is the
Long Range
build. For the attachment you want to use:
Cronen R808
Optic,
FSS IS300
Muzzle,
Hanbit Lightning-7 465mm
Barrel,
45 Round Mag
Magazine,

Ammunition.
Is the Han 86 easy to use?
The Han 86 has a base EaseScore of 6.5/10. Easescore is a proprietary metric to evaluate how easy a gun is to use. The higher it is, the easier the gun is.
What is the Han 86 TTK or Time To Kill in Warzone?
With the
Long Range
loadout, the Han 86 has a weighted average time to kill of 648ms from 0 to 10m, 648ms from 10 to 40m, 742ms from 40 to 80m and 835ms from 80 to 120m.

What is the Han 86 pick rate?
The current Han 86 pick rate is 4.2%. Pick rate is a useful indicator of how popular the weapon is in the current Warzone meta, but it should always be compared with its Loadout quality, TTK, recoil control, and overall ranking.
In which Call of Duty games is the Han 86 meta?
The Han 86 is currently part of the meta in
Warzone
,
Modern Warfare 4
. Its exact ranking and best builds are listed for each game on this page.
How many attachments are available for the Han 86?
The Han 86 can be equipped with 67 different attachments. You can browse them all, with their unlock levels, in the Attachments section above.
How do you unlock camos for the Han 86?
Every camo for the Han 86 has its own challenge to complete, spread across 2 camo grinds:
Weapon Camos
,
Weapon Prestige
. You can track your progress for each of them with the CODMunity camo tracker.
Has the Han 86 been nerfed or buffed recently?
Yes. The Han 86 has received 3 balance adjustments; the most recent one arrived in Season 1 on 13/11/2026. The full balancing history is listed on this page.
Is the Han 86 getting more or less popular?
At the start of the tracked period the Han 86 had a pick rate of 0.00%; it now sits at 4.26%. The daily evolution is charted in the Pick Rate Evolution section above.
